text: Hypothesis validated: Director proof plans need an explicit reachability check against the verifier observation model before paid Engineer build/repair begins. Harbor Courier canary #2 used a 75-second gameplay timeout while the base verifier observed only 12 seconds and also expected one proof path to cover mutually exclusive success and failure plus restart. The validated repair compiles a proof plan after Director traceability and fails closed before Engineer spend if required proof scenarios are unreachable. The existing short active+idle technical control remains unchanged. Product terminal evidence is now gathered only when required through independent harness-owned browser scenarios: active for success, idle for timeout failure, stopping immediately when the target state is observed. Restart is proven by an actual harness-observed terminal-to-playing transition rather than a generated fresh_run_started self-attestation event. The Product Proof window is bounded and explicit. This candidate remains inactive and is not promoted as an active production lesson.
